messages:
anya: FYI saw a pattern in the postmortem — route-priority fallback caused cross-region traffic to bounce and trigger TLS handshake resets. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/1822
samir: Can you paste the minimal log snippet? Wondering if it's SNI mismatch or connection reset.
tess: example from edge logs:
```
edge-324: client->lb: TLSv1.3 Handshake, ALPN h2
lb-12: selected backend eu-west-1a
lb-12: backend reset after 1 attempt, retrying -> routed to us-east-1b
client: TLS alert: handshake_failure
```
adrian: looks like our route-priority matrix let a lower-priority route win when health-check latency spiked -> asymmetric backend selection on retry.
anya: Proposed actions:
- A1: add strict route-preference tie-break (owner: samir, due: 2026-03-26)
- A2: enforce SNI sanity check in LB before retry (owner: tess, due: 2026-03-29)
- A3: add regression unit test for cross-region retry path (owner: adrian, due: 2026-04-02)
samir: I can take A1. Patch ready, will open PR today and request review from @tess.
adrian: For A3 I'll add an integration job that simulates high health-check latency and validates route selection. ETA 1 week.
tess: For A2, adding SNI sanity in LB won't be fully backward compatible for some on-prem customers. I'll prototype an opt-in flag, then roll to default after a week of monitor. owner: tess, opt-in flag -> 2026-03-29, default rollout 2026-04-05.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: PR #2237 -> canary eu-west-1a (started), notify @eng-oncall when canary passes.
anya: Action item tracker:
- samir -> A1 -> PR#2237 -> canary 03/24
- tess -> A2 -> RFC + feature flag -> canary 03/29
- adrian -> A3 -> test harness + integration job -> 04/02
Please post status updates in this thread. I'll consolidate into the postmortem follow-ups doc.
samir: quick check-in: PR raised, added unit tests for tie-break, PTAL @tess
adrian: started test harness branch, planning to run nightly sims and report failures.
tess: created RFC draft: https://redwood.internal/rfc/117-sni-sanity
anya: thanks all. Next check-in Friday 15:00 PT. :thumbsup:
